scheme_name: Assistance on Death- Haryana Silicosis Board
description:
The Assistance on Death scheme under the Haryana Silicosis Board was launched to provide financial support to the families of individuals who have succumbed to silicosis. 

Silicosis is a chronic lung disease caused by inhaling fine silica dust. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board was established in 2015 to address the health issues arising from this occupational disease. 

The scheme aims to alleviate the financial burden on the families of deceased workers who suffered from silicosis. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide a one-time financial assistance of ₹5 lakh to the family of the deceased. 

This assistance is intended to help the family cope with the loss of income and cover funeral expenses. 

The scheme was officially launched on 18th December 2015. 

The Haryana government recognized the need for such a scheme due to the increasing number of silicosis cases in the state, particularly among workers in the stone-crushing and mining industries. 

The scheme is specifically targeted at families of workers who have been diagnosed with silicosis and have subsequently passed away due to the disease. 

To be eligible for assistance, the deceased individual must have been a resident of Haryana. 

The individual must have been engaged in work that exposed them to silica dust. 

There are no specific age limits for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, the deceased must have been diagnosed with silicosis by a recognized medical authority. 

The family must provide proof of the diagnosis along with the application for assistance. 

The application process involves several steps. 

First, the family must obtain a death certificate of the deceased individual. 

Next, they must gather medical records that confirm the diagnosis of silicosis. 

The family must then fill out the application form provided by the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

This form can be obtained from the local office of the Haryana Silicosis Board or downloaded from their official website. 

Along with the application form, the family must submit the death certificate, medical records, and proof of residence. 

All documents must be submitted in original along with photocopies. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

The board will verify the documents and the diagnosis before approving the assistance. 

The timeline for processing the application is typically around 30 days from the date of submission. 

Once approved, the financial assistance of ₹5 lakh is disbursed directly to the bank account of the deceased's family. 

The assistance is provided in a lump sum amount to ensure that the family has immediate access to funds. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana. 

The contact details for the Haryana Silicosis Board can be found on the official Haryana government website. 

The board also conducts awareness programs to educate workers about silicosis and preventive measures. 

In addition to financial assistance, the Haryana Silicosis Board aims to provide medical support and rehabilitation for affected individuals. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to improve occupational health and safety standards. 

As of 2023, the Haryana Silicosis Board has processed numerous applications and disbursed significant amounts of financial assistance to families in need. 

The government has also been working on improving the identification and diagnosis of silicosis cases in the state. 

Regular health check-ups and screenings are conducted in industries prone to silica dust exposure. 

The Haryana government has set a target to reduce the incidence of silicosis through various preventive measures. 

These measures include enforcing stricter regulations on dust control in industries. 

The board collaborates with various stakeholders including labor unions and health organizations to achieve its objectives. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is crucial for families who have lost their primary breadwinners due to occupational diseases. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board also aims to create a database of silicosis cases in the state. 

This database will help in better understanding the disease and formulating effective policies for prevention and treatment. 

The board is also working towards improving the living conditions of affected families through various welfare programs. 

The Assistance on Death scheme is a significant step towards recognizing the plight of workers in hazardous occupations. 

It underscores the importance of occupational health and safety in the state of Haryana. 

The Haryana government continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme to ensure that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

The board has also been proactive in addressing grievances and providing support to families facing challenges in the application process. 

In conclusion, the Assistance on Death scheme under the Haryana Silicosis Board is a vital initiative aimed at supporting families affected by silicosis. 

With a financial assistance of ₹5 lakh, the scheme provides immediate relief to families who have lost their loved ones due to this preventable disease. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board remains committed to improving the health and safety of workers in the state. 

Through this scheme and other initiatives, the government aims to create a safer working environment for all. 

The ongoing efforts to raise awareness and provide support reflect the government's dedication to occupational health. 

Families affected by silicosis can find hope and assistance through the provisions of this scheme. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board continues to play a crucial role in addressing the challenges faced by these families. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to worker welfare and health. 

Overall, the Assistance on Death scheme is an essential component of Haryana's approach to managing occupational health issues. 

It serves as a model for similar initiatives in other states across India. 

The ongoing evaluation and improvement of the scheme will ensure its effectiveness in the future. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board remains a key player in the fight against occupational diseases. 

The financial assistance provided is not just a monetary benefit but a recognition of the sacrifices made by workers. 

The scheme is a crucial lifeline for families navigating the challenges of loss and financial instability. 

The Haryana government continues to strive for better health outcomes for its workforce through such welfare schemes. 

The Assistance on Death scheme exemplifies the importance of government intervention in protecting workers' rights and health.
